product_one_liner.value: Curve Dental provides cloud-based dental practice management software for dental practices, combining scheduling, charting, imaging, billing, payments and patient communication.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing/value page describes included features and startup pricing, but does not publish numerical subscription prices.

founded_year.notes: Uses the company’s current About page; the older 2018 investment announcement instead states 2005.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents dental practice education, product and marketing content; no qualifying engineering-authored technical blog was established.

public_docs.notes: Public help articles cover AI Notes+, voice charting, periodontal charting, phrasing and microphone setup.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current openings list contains development, IT and implementation roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Curve explicitly names Pearl AI for imaging and Mango Voice for AI call summaries; these disclosures do not identify an underlying foundation model for Curve Care+ or Ask CurveAI.

compliance_certs.notes: Attribution matters: Curve claims to follow HIPAA; SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are attributed to its hosting data center/AWS, not a separately evidenced Curve corporate certification. HIPAA is a compliance claim, not an independent certification.

last_funding.notes: Battery Ventures’ significant equity investment was announced February 8, 2018; the amount was not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified financing is the February 2018 Battery investment, before May 9, 2025. The August 2026 $200 million R&D commitment is not a funding round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Sales Development Representative posting shows an Apply option and was displayed as posted one month ago; the official careers-board snapshot does not separately display its title.

launched_6mo.notes: Curve Memberships was announced September 3, 2026, inside May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Rick Hansen was appointed Chief Customer Officer on September 29, 2026, within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly names SFDC and Salesloft for tracking prospects, opportunities and CRM activity; SFDC denotes Salesforce.
